{

  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is for an upward reserve-sizing study in CISO with default horizon and penalty. The defaults are interpreted as horizon_minutes=60 and cost_shortfall=20.0, with cost_reserve=1.0. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "CISO is an allowed region. The default horizon is interpreted as 60 minutes and the default shortfall cost as 20.0, both allowed values. The rolling design is fixed as train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, and rolling_step_days=30. No future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, or approval bypass is requested.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_decision_time_safe_features",
    "apply_fixed_rolling_window_design",
    "run_verified_numerical_reserve_sizing_workflow",
    "route_outputs_for_human_approval"
  ]
}
